shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"'"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log(request.nextUrl.pathname)
+
+  const response = NextResponse.next()
+  response.headers.set('X-Request-Id', randomUUID())
+
+  return response
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && cat tsconfig.json && git diff --check && npm run start -- --port 34567'

/bin/bash -c "for count in 1 2; do curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null 'http://localhost:34567/'; done | rg -i '"'^(HTTP/|x-request-id:)'"' && curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null 'http://localhost:34567/nonexistent' | rg -i '"'^(HTTP/|x-request-id:)'"'"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff --check && nl -ba proxy.ts && git diff -- tsconfig.json && ls -ld .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'

/bin/bash -c 'find .next -type f -delete && find .next -type l -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete && unlink next-env.d.ts && unlink tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && git diff --check'
